memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The servant asked him, 'What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?' 'Make sure that you do not take my son back there,' Abraham said. 'The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father's household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, "To your offspring I will give this land"—he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there. If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.' So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter." - Gen 24:5-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The servant asks a fair question: what if she says no? Abraham's answer is full of faith, yet also honest. He is sure God will send His angel ahead to prepare the way. But he does not pretend everything is guaranteed — if the woman refuses, the servant is released from the oath. What Abraham will not allow is for Isaac to be taken back to the old land.

This is a beautiful picture of trusting God without forcing outcomes. Abraham believes God will lead, yet he leaves room for how God might answer. He holds the promise firmly and the details loosely.

We often want guarantees before we take a step. But faith usually walks with an open hand — confident in God's character, unsure of the exact path. Abraham could say "He will send his angel before you" because he remembered how God had already led him out of his father's house years ago. Past faithfulness gave him present courage.

When you face a step where the answer isn't guaranteed, remember what God has already done in your life. The One who led you this far will not abandon you now.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where am I demanding guarantees before I trust God?
2. What past faithfulness can give me courage today?
3. Am I holding God's promises firmly and the details loosely?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You have led me faithfully until now. Give me courage to take the next step, trusting Your character even when the outcome is unclear. Amen.
